name: promise-pool
description: Executes async tasks over an array of items with a configurable concurrency limit, preserving input order.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you want to execute many async operations (like API calls, database reads, or file downloads) but need to restrict active concurrency (e.g. limit to 5 parallel tasks) to avoid rate limits or exhaustion.

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: Array of input items to process.

parameters.name: fn
parameters.description: Async function mapping each item to a promise: (item, index) => Promise<any>.

parameters.name: concurrency
parameters.description: Maximum number of promises running concurrently.
